Usage:
  agentrecall <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                 Create the local data directory and database
  setup                Ensure the .NET tools directory is on your PATH
  claude-code init     Wire AgentRecall's hooks + CLAUDE.md guidance for
                       Claude Code (no dev container scaffolding)
  devcontainer init    Same wiring, plus --create scaffolds a dev container
                       that reinstalls it on every rebuild
  feedback add         Record feedback and extract a pending rule
  rules list           List all rules (--status <status>, e.g. Pending)
  rules show <id>      Show a single rule in detail
  rules approve <id>   Move a Pending rule to Active
  rules promote <id>   Promote a rule
  rules supersede <oldId> <newId>
                       Replace one rule with another
  rules archive <id>   Archive a rule (excluded from search)
  rules conflicts      List detected rule conflicts and the chosen winner (--json)
  rules explain <id>   Explain a rule's confidence from its outcome history
  outcome record       Record an outcome (TestsPassed, UserAccepted, …) and adjust confidence
  lessons mine         Mine repeated historical signals into suggested lesson candidates
  lessons list|show|accept|reject
                       Review mined candidates; accept turns one into a rule
  lifecycle suggest    Recommend lifecycle actions (promote/archive/supersede/review)
  lifecycle list|show|apply|reject
                       Review recommendations; suggest is dry-run unless --apply
  search "<query>"     Search rules by keyword, ranked
  inject-context "<task>"
                       Build agent-ready context (must-follow, warnings,
                       preferred/anti-patterns) for a task
  import build-log <file>
  import test-log <file>
  import lint-log <file>
                       Ingest a failure log into events
  import pr-comments <file>
                       Capture PR review comments as pendi
